wording: Self-monitoring improves behaviour primarily when self-related estimates can alter subsequent computation or action.

decision_rule.retain_if: Across both held-out self-relevant task families, mean S2-minus-S1 accuracy is >=0.12 and at least 18/20 seeds favour S2; on matched self-irrelevant controls the absolute S2-minus-S1 mean accuracy difference is <=0.05.
decision_rule.restrict_if: The active-monitor benefit is reliable in only one registered task family or the matched irrelevant-task specificity criterion fails.
decision_rule.reduce_if: S1 passive monitoring matches S2 across both decisive self-relevant families.
decision_rule.reject_if: Allowing the self-monitor to influence control produces no reproducible selective benefit.
